title: Risk manager - avp
description:
About the Company
Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.
Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.
Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.
About the Role
The Risk Manager (AVP) will strengthen the company’s risk management framework, with focus on financial risks , and regulatory reporting for a financial institution in Brazil. This role plays a critical function in ensuring robust risk practices, aligned with Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen) requirements, internal risk appetite, and group standards. Experience in designing risk processes for regulatory authorization is a strong advantage.
Responsibilities
1. Risk Management Framework & Governance
Develop, enhance, and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, ensuring alignment with BCB, CMN Resolutions, and group risk standards.
Define and update risk policies, risk appetite statements (RAS), and risk taxonomy.
Support risk governance forums, including preparation of materials for Risk Committees and Board-level reporting.
2. Financial Risk Models and Controls
Lead risk assessment models, monitoring, and controls across lending products, investments, credit, and FIDC structures.
Oversee operational risk management, including risk & control self-assessments (RCSA), incident reporting, KRI monitoring, third-party risk, and business continuity aspects.
Evaluate new products, initiatives, and partnerships, conducting Risk & Compliance Assessment (RCA) and issuing signoffs.
3. Regulatory Reporting & Bacen Interface
Coordinate periodic submissions to Bacen, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.
Prepare risk-related regulatory documentation and respond to RFIs, audits, and supervisory requests.
Support the company's regulatory authorization process, including designing risk controls tailored for licensing requirements.
4. Data & Analytics
Develop and enhance risk dashboards, models, and automated reporting for credit, operational, and financial risk indicators.
Use data insights to inform business decisions and risk mitigation strategies.
Skills, Experiences & Qualifications
Hands-on leadership style with the ability to make sound technical decisions.
Experience in structuring risk process for financial or payment institutions , including regulatory compliance requirements. Bachelor's degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.
7+ years of experience in Risk functions within financial institutions, fintechs or risk metrics platforms.
Strong knowledge of Bacen and CMN regulations (ex.: Res. 4.557, 4.970, 4.953).
Prior involvement in Bacen authorization/licensing projects is highly valued. Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).
Strong analytical mindset and quantitative skills.
Structured problem-solving and risk-based decision making.
High level of ownership, organization, and stakeholder management.

Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais, padrões de comunicação e segurança da informação.

Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em Qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
A Clínica Esp Aaço Cres Ccer é uma das clínicas pioneiras dedicada exclusivamente ao Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA) em Porto Alegre. Foi fundada em 2004 pela Terapeuta Ocupacional Jerusa Ferri Chamun e, atualmente, conta com duas unidades: a Kids e a Adultos. Acreditamos em uma abordagem transdisciplinar sempre considerando as singularidades de cada paciente. Por isso, contamos com uma equipe de profissionais das áreas de: FONOAUDIOLOGIA, PSICOPEDAGOGIA, PSICOLOGIA E TERAPIA OCUPACIONAL.
No programa Clínico são realizados atendimentos individuais de 30 minutos com cada paciente conforme a indicação terapêutica. Os horários e datas dos atendimentos são determinados de acordo com a preferência da família e disponibilidade da clínica, podendo ser realizado mais de um atendimento por dia. Não trabalhamos com apenas uma abordagem teórica, evidenciamos a necessidade de colocarmos o paciente como centro da terapêutica para assim adequarmos a melhor abordagem para cada paciente.
Na especialidade de Fonoaudiologia trabalhamos basicamente com as seguintes demandas: transtornos alimentares como seletividade e aversão alimentar, comunicação aumentativa e alternativa, terapias de linguagem no geral. Além disso, por se tratar de uma equipe transdisciplinar também trabalhamos em conjunto: socialização, acolhimento de demandas cotidianas (família, escola, grupos e meios sociais), flexibilidade cognitiva (generalização de habilidades aprendidas), autogerenciamento (controle de impulso, autorregulação), promoção da autoeficácia e autoestima e acompanhamento com os pais.
 
PRINCIPAIS ABORDAGENS E MÉTODOS UTILIZADOS: Análise do comportamento - trabalha na aquisição de novas habilidades sociais e funcionais/ diminuição/extinção de comportamentos não adequados; TCC Infantil - a Terapia Cognitivo-Comportamental (TCC) Infantil trabalha na formação de conceitos globais, valores, cognição social, processos de modelagem/ modelação, expressão das emoções, causa/consequência e flexibilidade; Abordagem Naturalista - intervenção “natural” , próxima da realidade e das preferências da criança, potencializando a generalização; Modelo Precoce de Denver - intervenção que tem como objetivo qualificar a interação, imitação e pró atividade da criança; Neuropsicologia - rastreamento e entendimento dos processos mentais (atenção, memória, cognição, funções executivas), para fins avaliativos ou de estimulação.
Além dos atendimentos individuais nossos pacientes passam parte do tempo em que estão na clínica sendo estimulados em sala coletiva tendo como parâmetro o Programa TEACCH. Dessa forma, eles entram às 09h e saem às 11h50min (esse tempo engloba os atendimentos individuais e o atendimento em sala de grupo como estratégia organizadora o Programa TEACCH).
 
As evoluções mensais dos pacientes deverão estar na pasta compartilhada com a equipe e a cada seis meses é realizada uma avaliação abrangendo os objetivos trabalhados, a forma e técnicas utilizadas além da evolução do caso.
HORÁRIOS: segundas, quintas e sextas das 08h50min às 12h e terças das 08h50min às 13h (sendo que das 12h às 13h é horário de reunião de equipe).
 
PAGAMENTO: trabalhamos com pagamentos mensais independente se tiver atendimento ou não, com contrato de prestação de serviços. Feriados, feriadões e férias não são descontados, só é feito se o profissional faltar.

title: Senior lead technology architect
description:
DP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect
Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day? Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?
In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.
To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Here's what you can expect on a typical day:
Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities; Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success; Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors; Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks; Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought; Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;
WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:
Experience and Skills:
Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS Share Point, Webex and MS Office & Project;
Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
Strong knowledge of Flutter, React or Stencil. JS
Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
Experience in the frontend environment
Advanced English; Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups. Be very competent using tools such as MS Power Point;
Education: Degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or related field: A university degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job; PMP certified or equivalent - exceptional foundation project management skills. Must be able to demonstrate a full understanding of the product development and release management life cycles; Certified Scrum Master - be able to demonstrate and show previous experience running agile project teams.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!
Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.
In this role you will: (responsibilities)
Overview The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.
Key Responsibilities API Design & Development Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders. API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes. Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM). Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development. API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards. Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments. API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework. Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards. Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.
API Consumer Onboarding Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers. Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms. Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.
Testing & Validation Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability. Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.
Skills and Expertise API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles. Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management. Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices. Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards. Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool
What can you expect from us?
• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!
Como será seu dia a dia aqui:
Reportando-se ao Coordenador de Compras, sua principal responsabilidade será apoiar operacionalmente a área de compras, emitindo pedidos de compra, realizando cotações e monitorando alterações de preço aplicados por fornecedores, permitindo a entrega e aquisição de produtos solicitados pelas áreas e colaboradores da empresa.

title: Assistente financeiro (vaga afirmativa para pcd)
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars
Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.
Sobre Nós
Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.
Sua Jornada Conosco
Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.
Sobre a área
Na nossa Contabilidade você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo contábil desde o início de um projeto até o fim!
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Realizar lançamentos e conciliações bancárias;
Controlar contas a pagar e a receber;
Emitir e conferir notas fiscais;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios financeiros e fechamento mensal;
Realizar contato com fornecedores e clientes para tratativas financeiras;
Apoiar em atividades de cobrança e controle de inadimplência;
Alimentar e organizar planilhas de controle interno;
Auxiliar na organização de documentos e arquivamento de comprovantes.
Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento em Excel (nível intermediário é um diferencial);
Desejável experiência prévia na área financeira;
Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação.
Benefícios

Serviço de telemedicina;
Rede de academias;
Canal de apoio psicológico;
Convênio com o SESC;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Transporte;
Assistência Médica;
Assistência Odontológica;
Seguro de vida
Estamos comprometidos com a diversidade e a inclusão, e por isso esta oportunidade é destinada exclusivamente a Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) .
Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), organizado(a) e com vontade de crescer, para atuar em nossa equipe contábil, contribuindo com as rotinas da área e com a melhoria contínua dos nossos processos.
